chunks: 2789 - Ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who forgot Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ, he said: “If he completed more than half and left forgetfully, he should instruct someone to perform tawaf on his behalf, and he may approach women if he completed more than half.”
And it is narrated: “Whoever omitted Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ, if he had performed Ṭawāf al-Wadāʿ, then that is Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ.”

key_terms.طَوَافَ ٱلنِّسَاءِ: The tawaf whose completion permits marital relations after the pilgrimage rites.
key_terms.طَوَافَ ٱلْوَدَاعِ: The farewell tawaf, here reported as counting for Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ.
key_terms.نَاسِيًا: Forgetfully; indicating the omission was unintentional.
key_terms.يَطُوفُ عَنْهُ: To perform tawaf on his behalf by deputation.
key_terms.يَقْرَبَ ٱلنِّسَاءَ: To resume lawful conjugal approach to women.
key_terms.ٱلنِّصْفِ: Half; the legal threshold mentioned in the ruling.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ after completing more than half of it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about one who forgets Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ during hajj or ʿumrah rites. It states that if more than half was completed before leaving, another person may perform it on his behalf, and it also reports that Ṭawāf al-Wadāʿ may suffice for Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ in such a case.
